remarks: Welcome to 185 Regents Park, an award-winning gated community in Westport offering an exceptional blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience. From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the beautifully landscaped grounds and 24-hour security. Step inside this elegant townhouse and be greeted by a grand, light-filled foyer with double skylights that opens to a spacious living and dining area. The living room features built-in bookcases, a dry bar, and a cozy fireplace - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Two sets of sliders lead to a private deck, seamlessly connecting you to the outdoors. The eat-in kitchen offers generous counter space, hardwood floors, stainless-steel appliances, and skylights that fill the room with natural light. Upstairs, you'll find the laundry area and a luxurious primary suite with a comfortable sitting or office area, exceptional closet space, and a convenient kitchenette - perfect for your morning coffee. The en-suite bath includes both a walk-in shower and a soaking tub. The fully finished lower level provides flexible space for a den, home office, gym, or guest room. Community amenities include a pool, tennis courts, and a clubhouse. This residence offers the perfect opportunity to add your own personal touches and create your dream home. Conveniently located near Westport's renowned restaurants, shops, beaches, the Playhouse, and Longshore Golf Course, 185 Regents Park delivers the best of luxury living in an unbeatable location.
